text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is distraught at being separated from Satono Diamond, her lifelong friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio and Nice Nature are worried for their younger friend and offer Kitasan Black their assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a long discussion about whose tutelage she would benefit most from, Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen become her mentors.
